segment_captions.caption: Baby holds orange ball in mouth, looking around.
Baby holds orange ball, shifts position slightly, continues chewing on it.
Baby holds orange ball, then looks around while still holding it.
Baby in bouncer holds orange ball, then reaches down towards leg strap, adjusting it slightly.

Baby lies in a colorful bouncer, holding a small orange ball with blue dots. The baby's right hand moves slightly while the left hand rests on the bouncer. The baby looks around, then focuses on the ball.
Baby looks around while holding an orange ball in the left hand.
